# ADR-030 — Dispatch status `accepted` means Expo accepted the request, not device delivery; receipt polling deferred

**Status:** Locked for MVP

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Notification dispatch status `accepted` means Expo accepted the request, not confirmed device delivery; receipt polling is deferred
